verdict.rationale: Blaxel is presented entirely as a managed serverless/cloud platform (sandboxes, MCP hosting, jobs, agent drive) with no mention of a self-hosted/on-prem deployment option, Docker Compose, Helm chart, or open-source core that a user could run themselves. Missing for 10: any documentation of self-hosting instructions, open-source repo for the core runtime, or on-prem/air-gapped deployment support.
